# Organ Surgery
The heart, lungs, liver, kidneys and stomach are in the [bold]chest[/bold], so every chest organ surgery needs the incision and the bone cavity opened first, and the bone cavity closed at the end. The brain needs the skull opened; the eyes only need an incision. For what each organ does, see [textlink="Organs" link="CMUGuideMedicalOrgans"].
Every organ surgery starts by clamping that organ's vessels with an [bold]organ clamp[/bold].
## Suture an Organ Repairs a damaged heart, lungs, liver, kidneys or stomach. 1. [italic]Open the incision, then the bone cavity.[/italic]
2. Clamp the organ's vessels with an [bold]organ clamp[/bold].
3. Suture the organ with a [bold]hemostat[/bold].
4. [italic]Close the bone cavity.[/italic]
## Remove an Organ Takes out the heart, lungs, liver, kidneys or stomach. 1. [italic]Open the incision, then the bone cavity.[/italic]
2. Clamp the organ's vessels with an [bold]organ clamp[/bold].
3. Extract the organ with a [bold]hemostat[/bold].
4. [italic]Close the bone cavity.[/italic]
## Replace an Organ Puts a donor organ into the lungs, liver, kidneys or stomach. Remove the old one first. 1. [italic]Open the incision, then the bone cavity.[/italic]
2. Clamp the organ's vessels with an [bold]organ clamp[/bold].
3. Insert the replacement organ: hold it in your hand and use it on the patient.
4. [italic]Close the bone cavity.[/italic]
## Transplant Heart The heart has its own procedure. Remove the old heart first. 1. [italic]Open the incision, then the bone cavity.[/italic]
2. Clamp the heart vessels with an [bold]organ clamp[/bold].
3. Transplant the donor heart: hold it in your hand and use it on the patient.
4. [italic]Close the bone cavity.[/italic]
## Repair Brain 1. [italic]Open the incision, then the skull.[/italic]
2. Clamp the brain vessels with an [bold]organ clamp[/bold].
3. Repair the brain with a [bold]hemostat[/bold].
4. [italic]Close the skull.[/italic]
## Repair Eyes 1. [italic]Open the incision.[/italic]
2. Clamp the eye vessels with an [bold]organ clamp[/bold].
3. Repair the eyes with a [bold]hemostat[/bold].
4. Cauterize the incision shut with a [bold]cautery[/bold].
## Alien Embryo Removal 1. [italic]Open the incision, then the bone cavity.[/italic]
2. Cut the larva's roots with a [bold]scalpel[/bold].
3. Remove the larva with a [bold]hemostat[/bold].
4. [italic]Close the bone cavity.[/italic]
